origin.description: Tools for obtaining information about base packages.

arguments.name: verbose
arguments.text: logical. Should packages be listed as they are processed?

arguments.name: Ncpus
arguments.text: the number of parallel processes to use for processing.

origin.details: base_aliases_db() returns the Rd aliases in the base packages, as a nested per-package named list of per-Rd-file named lists with the aliases.
origin.value: A nested named list of character vectors.
origin.example:
db <- base_aliases_db(verbose = FALSE, Ncpus = 1L)
length(db)
names(db)
db[["stats"]][["acf.Rd"]]

translation.description: Tools for obtaining information about base packages.

arguments.name: verbose
arguments.text: When True, print each package name as it is processed.

arguments.name: ncpus
arguments.text: Number of parallel worker processes for the base packages.

translation.details: base_aliases_db() returns the Rd aliases in the base packages, as a nested dict keyed by package name, then Rd file name, with alias strings as lists.
translation.value: A nested dict mapping package names to Rd file names to lists of alias strings.
translation.example:
from tools.base_aliases_db import base_aliases_db
db = base_aliases_db(verbose=False, ncpus=1)
print(len(db))
print(','.join(db))
print(','.join(db['stats']['acf.Rd']))
